capabilities: Display fullscreen slideshows of randomized images from a vault folder
Configure per-image duration presets and loop behavior
Log sessions to prioritize unseen images
Add optional intro prompt slides from markdown files
disambiguation: Not a random-note tool; it shuffles image files into fullscreen timed slideshows, not notes.
extras: Manual installation on mobile is possible but localization and the language dropdown work on desktop only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run timed, randomized image slideshows from vault folders for practice drills or presentations.
summary: Fullscreen slideshow player that shows images from a chosen vault folder in randomized order with timed auto-advance, breaks, and session logging.
